value.body: Designs the electrical side of buildings, factories and infrastructure — power distribution, lighting, earthing, cable sizing and panel layouts — and turns it into drawings and calculations that site teams follow. Employers include MEP design consultancies, EPC contractors and panel builders. A typical day is spent on load calculations, CAD drawings and coordination with architects, HVAC and site engineers.

items.label: Typical entry
items.note: A diploma in electrical engineering also leads to drafting and junior roles

items.label: Common tools
items.value: AutoCAD, electrical design and lighting software, Excel

items.label: Codes used
items.value: National Electrical Code, National Building Code and relevant IS standards

items.label: Installed power generation capacity
items.note: Utility capacity at the end of March 2025, of which coal was about 222 GW
items.source: Central Electricity Authority data, as reported (IEEFA, PIB)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Most freshers join an MEP consultancy, EPC contractor or panel manufacturer as a trainee or graduate engineer and learn design on live projects. Campus placement and referrals are the usual routes. A short course in AutoCAD and an electrical design or lighting tool is a common add-on.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Single-line diagrams and layouts in AutoCAD
Lighting design to required lux levels
Applying IS, NEC and NBC requirements

value.title: At a glance
items: Progression usually runs trainee → design engineer → senior or lead designer → design manager.
Site exposure in the early years makes design work easier, and some engineers move between site and design.
Hiring follows the construction and infrastructure cycle.
Related roles include MEP coordinator, electrical site engineer and solar design engineer.

competition.note: B.Tech / B.E. (all branches) graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
competition.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 34 (programme-wise out-turn), Ministry of Education

women.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 34 (programme-wise out-turn), Ministry of Education
